text:
Maria Chen: Quick thread to map the partner credit pools for next quarter's HW + SI marketplace push. Need ops + finance input. Keeping updates here so we have a single decision record.
Lee Patel: Can you drop last quarter's utilization top lines? want spend vs activation before we propose splits.
Maria Chen: Topline I pulled quickly: ~120 partners used credits, ~50k USD consumed, split ~45% HW promos / 30% SI integrations / 25% enablement. Sheet here: https://redwood.app/sheets/partner-credits-q2 (view only for now).
Derek Nguyen: Thanks — thinking we should bias towards co-fund for SI work. Proposed initial split: co-fund 60% / marketing credits 40%.
Alyssa Gomez: :thumbsup: Agree on co-fund tilt but we need a strategic reserve for our highest-impact partners.
Maria Chen: Rough proposal to discuss: three buckets — strategic reserve (20%), marketplace promotions (50%), enablement & learning credits (30%). Strategic reserve = top-6 partners + a small MSP pool.
Lee Patel: How are we defining "strategic"? We should derive from scorecard. Proposed score calc: SCORE = 0.4*pipeline + 0.3*joint_announcements + 0.3*active_customers.
Derek Nguyen: Can we run filter: partners with ARR >= 50k AND joint_events >= 2 in last 12 months => auto-qualify for reserve?
Alyssa Gomez: I'll run that query and paste results. Running now — will post CSV by EOD.
Alyssa Gomez: ```sql
SELECT partner_id, name, ARR, joint_events, last_joint_announcement
FROM partners
WHERE ARR >= 50000 AND joint_events >= 2;
```
Alyssa Gomez: Pushing CSV shortly.
Sophia Ruiz: finance here — we can allow up to 10% carryover into next period if there's a clear activation plan. Anything above 10% requires VP Finance signoff.
Maria Chen: Noted. So we should size the pool with a 10% buffer for carryover.
Lee Patel: I'll take the scorecard weights and run a ranking against Alyssa's CSV and return a top-20 list. Expect a short spreadsheet in ~3 hours.
Derek Nguyen: I'll draft the co-fund term sheet (simple eligibility, spend cliffs, reporting cadence). Will post a 1-pager for review.
Maria Chen: Action items summarized: 1) Alyssa: run partner filter + CSV (EOD) 2) Lee: apply scorecard weights + top-20 ranking (3h) 3) Derek: draft co-fund terms (tomorrow AM) 4) Sophia: confirm rollover policy in writing (EOD) 5) Maria: consolidate and schedule 30-min decision sync tomorrow 10:00am PT.
partner-bot: Reminder: monthly partner ops sync posted to calendar for tomorrow 10:00am PT (auto).
Alyssa Gomez: Confirmed — I'll also flag partners that need legal NDA refresh before co-fund issuance.
Sophia Ruiz: Sending a short note to finance-approvals for expected rollover ask; will attach Alyssa's CSV when available.
Lee Patel: One more ask — include a simple activation KPI for each credit: (a) onboarding completed within 30 days OR (b) joint event scheduled within 60 days. Otherwise credits expire.
Maria Chen: Good point. Put that in Derek's term-sheet TODO.
Derek Nguyen: Adding expiration and KPI clauses. Will call out reporting sample we want: partner name, credit used, activation date, outcome.
Maria Chen: OK folks — if no objections I'll pull the doc and invite the 30-min decision sync. If you want pre-reads, post in this thread. Thanks! :rocket:
